components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The optional honorific title of the pet owner. When supplied it must
            be one of MR, MRS, MS or DR. Used to compose the derived
            'salutation'. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward
            compatibility with the flat address form. On read this holds the
            composed address: the normalized 'addressLine1', with a single
            space and the normalized 'addressLine2' appended when an
            'addressLine2' was supplied. Optional on create when structured
            'addressLine1' is supplied instead.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: "(?s).*\\S.*"
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address
            (e.g. street number and name). Preferred over the flat 'address'
            when supplied; normalized on create with the same rules as
            'address' (trimmed, internal whitespace collapsed, upper-cased,
            common street-type abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: "(?s).*\\S.*"
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal
            address (e.g. unit or apartment). When supplied it is normalized
            with the same rules as 'addressLine1' and appended to the composed
            'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: "(?s).*\\S.*"
          example: 'Apt 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: "(?s).*\\S.*"
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create the value is
            normalized to E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped;
            a leading '+' and country code are kept, otherwise country code '+61'
            is assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the national
            digits. The result must be a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits; this
            E.164 value is stored and returned. For example '0412 345 678' is
            stored as '+61412345678'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-

The full suite (the two acceptance tests) is green. Here's a summary of what I implemented for the owner soft-delete change.

## Changes

**Domain model** — `model/Owner.java`
- Added a `deleted` field (`@Column(name = "deleted", nullable = false)`, primitive `boolean` defaulting to `false`) with `isDeleted()`/`setDeleted(...)`. A newly created owner is therefore `false`.

**Persistence schema** — `db/{hsqldb,h2,mysql,postgres}/schema.sql`
- Added a `deleted BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE NOT NULL` column to the `owners` table. The `DEFAULT FALSE` ensures the column-less seed inserts in `data.sql` load as `false` (required so `findAll()` can read legacy rows into the primitive field). Order is `DEFAULT ... NOT NULL` because HSQLDB requires the default clause first.

**DELETE becomes soft-delete** — `service/ClinicServiceImpl.java`
- `deleteOwner(...)` now sets `deleted = true` and `save`s the owner instead of removing the row. The controller still returns `204 No Content` (2xx), and `GET /api/owners/{id}` continues to find and return the owner.

**Create checks ignore deleted owners**
- `ClinicServiceImpl.isHouseholdInUse(...)` skips deleted owners (the 409 household-conflict check).
- `OwnerRestControllerV1.isIdentityKeyInUse(...)` skips deleted owners (the 409 identity-key check).
- `OwnerRestControllerV1.findPossibleDuplicate(...)` also filters out deleted owners for consistency with the duplicate-detection rule.

**API contract** — `openapi.yml`
- Added a read-only `deleted` boolean to the `Owner` schema so the generated `OwnerDto` carries it and GET serializes it (MapStruct maps `Owner.deleted` → `OwnerDto.deleted` by name).

Both acceptance tests (`coreSoftDeleteFlagsAndRetains`, `coreDeletedOwnerIgnoredByDuplicateCheck`) pass — `BUILD SUCCESS`, `Tests run: 2, Failures: 0, Errors: 0`.
